claims.text: The execution logs for containers container_1445144423722_0020_01_000006 and container_1445144423722_0020_01_000007 show a similar pattern of events, with both containers being assigned to task attempts and launched remotely on the same node, MSRA-SA-41.fareast.corp.microsoft.com:7109.

However, a closer look reveals that the task attempt for container_1445144423722_0020_01_000006 is using the same container ID as its attempt ID, suggesting that the task attempt may not have been properly assigned to the container.
In contrast, the task attempt for container_1445144423722_0020_01_000007 has a distinct attempt ID, indicating that it was successfully assigned to the container.
This pattern of events suggests that the task attempt for container_1445144423722_0020_01_000006 may have failed to properly initialize, resulting in a task failure.
